reason: £18 for one pouch from a brand I've never heard of, on its own website and not on Amazon, plus I'd probably pay delivery because it's under £30. I'd rather wait for a halal collagen deal on Amazon or a Holland & Barrett offer.
objection: I don't want to be pushed into a subscription to get the decent price, and I'm not sure collagen actually does much for my joints, so paying full whack to try it feels like a gamble.
would_change_my_mind: A proper first-order deal without a subscription, like the first pouch for around £10 with free delivery, or seeing it on Amazon with reviews I trust.
